# RepoSentinel
> Native macOS app (SwiftUI/SwiftPM) that scans a Mac, local git repos and GitHub for the PolinRider worm and triages hits with Apple's on-device FoundationModels.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): commands, layout, invariants for coding agents
- [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): scan lifecycle, pause/stop, verdict logic
- [README.md](README.md): features, install, privacy
